## Proposed Changes

Provide a clear description of the problem solved, architectural implications, and what code blocks changed.

## Type of Change

Please mark options that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that alters existing behaviors)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Pre-Merge Quality Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please verify:
- [ ] **Clean Compilation**: `pnpm build` executes with zero TypeScript compiler errors or warnings.
- [ ] **Security Sanitization**: Secrets, API keys, and credentials have been stripped from files.
- [ ] **Tests Coverage**: Unit/Integration tests cover critical paths (>90%).
- [ ] **Zero Trust Rules**: New endpoints verify request authorization scopes.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Flagship guides, API specs, and CHANGELOG entries updated.
